name: create_role
description: Create a new role in the Discord server with optional color and permissions

role_name.description: The name of the role to create

color.description: Optional: Hex color code for the role (e.g., '#ff0000' or '0xff0000'). Leave empty for default.

hoist.description: Optional: Whether the role should be displayed separately in the sidebar. Defaults to false.

reason.description: Optional: Reason for creating the role.
